items.detail: CLAIM REVIEWED (not ours, and not about our data): “A Muslim man destroyed an image of Hindu goddess Saraswati by kicking it” - attributed to Anand Kumar. Reviewed by Alt News (altnews.in). Their rating, in their words: “False”. MATCHED BY NAME: this review was found by searching fact-checkers' databases for “Anand Kumar”, not by any identifier. Names are shared, so it may concern a different person of the same name - read the article before relying on it. Read it: https://www.altnews.in/video-of-a-man-kicking-photo-of-hindu-diety-saraswati-shared-with-false-communal-angle/
